batch: Revamp S2 Customer Work: Wave 2 phase 2, the Work list on /account?view=work
kind: Screen built to docs/revamp/specs/home-work.md on top of the work-item adapter (PR 268). Existing panels stay mounted and visible.
findingsNote: No gap is created or changed. No route, table, migration, switch or write is added.
status: Built on branch revamp/customer over the adapter commit. CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
newFiles: tests/integration/revamp-work-screen.test.ts (vitest, 31 tests: H-01, H-02, H-04, H-05, H-06, H-08 and row rules)
changedFiles: apps/web/app/account/page.tsx: reads `work` from the address, shows the list first in the Work view only when the workspace module is on, and adds one link 'See all your work' under the Home next-step card.

decisions.noDisclosure: The spec says the existing panels may move into a closed disclosure. They did not: about fifteen operator specs open /account?view=work and act on those panels, and a closed disclosure would hide them. Every panel, id and link stays in place and visible, so #customer-workspaces and #customer-requests land as today and H-03 holds without a disclosure.
decisions.countLine: No count line, because there is no disclosure.
decisions.selector: A real radio group in a GET form with a Show button, no script needed. Counts come from the items read and read 'N or more' whenever the list is partial, unreadable or has skipped workspaces.
decisions.titles: A request has no stored title, so its kind word is the heading. Nothing is invented.
decisions.statusWords: Existing sets only: customerStatusLabel for drafts and requests, the service-request status words for service requests. A programme has no status and shows none.

receipts.vitest: pnpm exec vitest run on revamp-work-items, revamp-work-screen, revamp-truth-states and ux-move-records: 4 files, 102 passed (local, node 22).
receipts.mutations: Treating an unreadable empty list as empty fails 3; dropping the 'or more' rule fails 3; accepting a raw work value fails 2; showing every row instead of twenty fails 1. Each restored.
receipts.checks: pnpm format:check, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck: exit 0 each (node scripts/gate.mjs receipts in work/). The first typecheck failed on my own test importing a .tsx file directly; fixed with the dynamic import the existing tests use.
receipts.layout: LOCAL APPROXIMATION, not CI-gated: the component rendered to HTML with the real globals.css and work-list.css inside main.ux-customer, measured in Chromium at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 with axe (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag22aa). Four states (25 rows with one failed source, true empty, unreadable, filtered empty): no sideways scroll, no action under 44px, axe clean in all 16 cases. Height of 20 rows with ordinary workspace names: 3.9 screens at 390, 2.7 at 768, 2.4 at 1440 of a 900px viewport (budget 4 and 2.5); 5.1 at 320, over the phone budget. With a 45-character workspace name in every row: 5.1 at 390.

notRun: The real /account page signed in: the verification server has no customer identity (KI-16), so H-07 is not proved in the real frame. CI's operator suite runs the existing panels but does not measure this list.
Keyboard walk-through with a screen reader.
Full integration, operator and Playwright suites (CI runs them on the pushed head).
sensitive: Reads only through the adapter, which keeps items in the person's own workspaces. Guardian review requested.
